description: The plain read: a listing of one scope, every learning with its tags, ordered by created_at. Provenance is ALWAYS shown (M3 — the label is never collapsed), and the observed count rides only with the observed learning (here, none are observed, so no count appears and none is a zero). An empty listing answers honestly — `learnings` is empty, nothing was refused.

learnings.body: the build needs the sqlite_fts5 tag
the CGO shim header must match go-sqlite3's version
